chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿĪsā ibn Mihrān, from Abū Ghānim, from Minhāl ibn Khalīl, from Salamah ibn Tammām, from ʿAlī عليه السلام:

Regarding an animal upon which there were two riders behind the main rider: if the animal killed a man or injured him, he عليه السلام ruled that the liability payment be divided equally between the two rear riders.

key_terms.دَابَّةٍ: a riding animal or beast involved in causing the harm
key_terms.رَدِيفَانِ: two persons riding behind another on the same animal

ai.seo_question: How is liability divided if a riding animal with two rear riders kills or injures someone?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning liability for harm caused by a riding animal. It establishes that when two rear riders are on the animal and it kills or injures someone, the financial liability is shared equally between them.
